title: Wizard Society Server Modpack
description: The official Wizard Society server modpack!
body:
The modpack for the Wizard Society private server. Focus on covering multiple mods with industry, wizardry, and enhanced vanilla mechanics while staying optimized for lower-end hardware.

**Mods include**

- Create + Create Aeronautics
- Towns and Taverns
- Iron's Spells n' Spellbooks
- Antique Atlas
- CC:Tweaked + Create compat
- Farmer's Delight
- Neighborly
- And More!
